description: This file defines a factory class for creating health checking actors within an Akka Actor system, specifically for the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to generate actor configuration properties based on provided options and child actor props, and manages the creation of health checking actors with optional persistence checks.

classes.name: DefaultHealthCheckingActorFactory
classes.description: A final utility class that provides static methods to create and configure health checking actors for the Ditto service ecosystem.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns an Akka `Props` object configured for a health checking actor, incorporating persistence and other child actors as specified by the passed options and props.
